executableProvenanceStop.interpretation: The frozen identity check hashes chromium.executablePath(), while default headless launch dispatches to chromium-headless-shell. A post-measurement hash cannot retroactively freeze the selected executable. Equal product versions do not establish executable identity.
executableProvenanceStop.measurements: Four completed triages are preserved as diagnostics with condition-contract checks; no formal confirmation or causal attribution is accepted.

metricSeparation: Logical Blob bytes, CDP heap/backing, native tracked requested bytes, hierarchical allocator stats and process private commit remain separate; never summed.
limitations: One host, reported product version and original corpus; four diagnostic triages only. The formal series was not executed, and runtime executable identity was not frozen.
Interaction is exploratory; only the selected one-factor contrast has formal confirmation.
A profiler changes execution cost; profiled absolute deltas are not interchangeable with unprofiled deltas.
MemoryInfra heaps_v2 exposes sampled live cohorts at timestamps, not proof of individual allocation identity or complete native heap coverage.
Hashes attest immutable source containers and server roundtrip before measurement; Blob-only runs do not rematerialize payloads to hash each response.
Residual private memory alone does not establish a leak or a specific native function.
